name: Seekers of the Lost Treasure III

scenes.summary: You find the "cave" mentioned in the secret message. After searching the place, you learn that a Qingbo Stockade resident once lived here. He succumbed to Oripathy due to excessive use of the Arts. Martina finally divulges that she is actually a traveling naturalist.

lines.text: From the clues we found at the scene, I'm afraid the one who left the third secret message has...
...This Stockade resident overused the Arts and succumbed to ⟦key|Oripathy⟧.
And like other victims of Oripathy ... all that's left of him are just a few personal belongings.
Oripathy is just a chronic condition these days... Most of us have forgotten how terrible it was in the past.
A terrible fate still awaits any patient who couldn't access enough suppressants.
Nothing has changed about Oripathy.
I know the Stockaders lack medical resources to handle complex diseases like this. He probably knew his fate when he wrote the secret message...
If only he could've gotten himself to Wuling City on time... The medical services there would have...
From what he wrote in his will, he actually trained his Arts to attack Wuling.
*Sigh* I'm just an outsider so I can't really comment... But I don't understand why anyone would harm themselves over a feud...
Why obsess about factions when this world offers so much beauty to focus on?
We've created so many traces of our existence upon this planet...
Martina...
I'm actually not a Tianshi...
What? You knew? Why did you keep helping me then?
It's like what you said. Factions aren't that important. But I do need to know why you disguised yourself as a Tianshi.
There are no special reasons, really. They give Tianshi outfits to ⟦key|visiting scholars⟧ like us.
Wearing it made me feel like I was part of the local community. It also gives an immersive experience of Wuling culture.
But I also got plenty of hate from the Stockaders. I guess that's part of the "immersion".
Oh, no you're not. I shall introduce myself again. I am Martina, a traveling ⟦key|naturalist⟧. Piot is my assistant.
I run a museum at ⟦key|La Fantoma⟧, where I showcase cultural artifacts gathered during my explorations.
Of course, I also host regular photo exhibitions. After all, not every beautiful thing can be procured. A photograph is a great alternative.
My intent is to help more people realize and appreciate the beauty of Talos-II.
That is indeed a very worthwhile pursuit, Miss Martina.
Heheh. Thanks! Oh, can you actually help me take a photo of these ⟦key|Originium clusters⟧ as well?

I don't intend to show this photo to the public, though. I just want to tell Wuling City of the situation here, and ask them to send people to help settle the final proof of this Stockader's existence...
What? Really? Did I take the wrong outfit? No wonder that Tianshi boy was giving me weird looks...
We can discuss the uniform later... I hope I'm not being too intrusive, but what exactly is your profession?

options: This is a farmer's uniform, actually...

scenes.summary: You deduce that a mother had secretly raised a child in this place. Then, due to some reasons, she placed the child in the basket and let the river carry it away. Her secret message includes her love and best wishes for the child. Everyone is moved by the sincere emotions conveyed in the message.

lines.text: This is a Stockader's mask.
No. This is a ... secret message too.
What does the message say?
May the water carry my wishes... My child... Forgive me for leaving your side...
Perhaps the mother was left with no choice but to say goodbye.
She must have had her reasons for raising a child under such harsh conditions...
...In the end, she had no choice but to ⟦key|give up⟧.
I didn't expect such a sad story in Qingbo Stockade.
And thus the children of Yan grew up in this world without deities, and devoted their boundless faith to the mountains and rivers... By the mountains they live, and upon the waters they depart.
The same mountains and rivers thus became a vessel of their sorrows and joys.
Speaking of which, what happened to the child mentioned in the secret message...
If we follow the flow of this river, the child probably ended up at Qingbo Stockade.
What are you talking about? Something mysterious?
Well, not my business anyway. Say, why don't we ⟦key|take a group photo⟧ as a memento?
You're right... I've traveled to many places after starting my adventures.
In the past, I only felt compelled to add the interesting artifacts to my collection back home as proof of my visits.
Now, I'm beginning to think that the open lands and skies themselves have marked the meaning of my ⟦key|"passage"⟧ through them...

options: The proof of your journey rests within your heart.
We should ask Tangtang if we have the chance.

scenes.summary: You escort Martina and Piot out of the cave. Martina suddenly plans to host a Qingbo Stockade cultural exhibition once she returns to La Fantoma, and eagerly invites you. You happily accept and then bid each other farewell.

lines.text: Now that I've learned so much about the Stockaders, I couldn't bring myself to hurt them!
Boss! Have you learned more about them, or are you just avoiding the fight?
I'm so starved I couldn't move a muscle. Quick. Throw me some food.
Tianshi Piot... I mean, Mr. Piot... We did tell you to stay at your place.
Yeah. *NOM* you could hardly *NOM* anything. What were you *NOM*king.
Sorry, sorry! I got a little worried since you were gone for such a long time.
...We then cracked all the secret messages! It was a true adventure worth remembering!
What? You went alone?
Not alone. I had Perlica and Masked Rogue in the team.
Before I forget, this Masked Rogue is simply astounding.
You better pick up some real skills once we get back, Piot.
But I've already done what you said and mastered photography, topography, natural navigation...
Okay, okay. I know what you can do.
Well, time really flies. I suppose this is where we conclude our local adventure.
It has been a most enjoyable trip so far. We saw another side of Qingbo Stockade.
Once we head back, we'll start organizing a Qingbo Stockade cultural exhibition. Please visit if you can!
I wonder if there's a way to send you the museum address and tickets.
Okay, boss. I've contacted the coach station. We'll soon be on the way back to La Fantoma.
Wonderful! I really miss a hot water bath.
Sure, boss. There's also this matter of us ... ⟦key|disguised as Tianshi⟧...
Yes. Miss Martina told us about that already.
I'm so sorry... We didn't mean to lie to you.
Masked Rogue, this isn't the best time to talk about embarrassing moments.
And relax, Piot. We're fellow explorers. That makes us friends.
I guess that's our cue. Thank you again, Perlica and Masked Rogue.
Thank you very much!
You're welcome, Miss Martina and Mr. Piot. Farewell.
Finish your meal, boss. We can talk later...

options: Martina got some jail time. That's punishment enough.
Piot actually understood the nom-nom talk?

lines.text: A few tattered pieces of clothing. The rips and holes seem to have been made from the inside...
